concerns.text: Task T015c (Longest Conjugated Path Length) is marked incomplete (unchecked), yet Task T019 (Write descriptor results) and T020 (Bond Order Annotation) depend on the `conjugation_length` column being present in the output. T019 explicitly lists `conjugation_length` in the required columns. Implementing T019 before T015c creates a consumer-before-producer violation.

Task T020 (Bond Order Annotation) depends on `conjugation_length` (from T015c) to compute `weighted_path_length`. T020 is marked incomplete, but T019 (which outputs the base descriptors) is also incomplete. The dependency chain T015c -> T019 -> T020 is broken. T019 cannot execute successfully without T015c completing first.

Task T021 (Electronegativity-Weighted Polarity) depends on the conjugated system structure defined in T020/T015c. T022 (Hückel Resonance Proxy) depends on `num_conjugated_double_bonds` which is derived from the conjugation logic in T015c. All three (T020, T021, T022) are marked incomplete, but T019 (the output task) is also incomplete. The ordering implies T019 should run after T015c, but T019 is currently blocked by the incomplete T015c, creating a deadlock in the execution plan for US1.

Task T027 (Scaffold Split) explicitly states 'AFTER T019 completes'. However, T019 is marked incomplete. T026 (Target Validation) is also incomplete. The plan assumes T019 produces `data/processed/descriptors.csv` which T027 consumes. If T019 is not completed, T027 cannot proceed. The ordering is correct (T019 before T027), but the incomplete status of the producer (T019) blocks the consumer (T027) and all subsequent US2 tasks.

Task T043 (Generate scatter plots) is marked as 'DEPENDENT ON T039, T040, T041, T042'. T039 (Iterative VIF loop) depends on T027 (Scaffold Split) and T029 (Model Training). T027 and T029 are incomplete. The dependency chain is valid, but the incomplete status of the upstream producers (T027, T029, T039) blocks T043. The ordering is semantically correct, but the plan is currently non-executable due to the incomplete state of the producer tasks.

Task T015c is marked incomplete, but T015 (Standard aromaticity) is marked complete. T015c is a distinct requirement (longest conjugated path) from T015 (ring count). The dependency of T019 on T015c is clear, but the visual grouping in Phase 3 might confuse the order of execution if T015c is not prioritized immediately after T015. Consider reordering T015c to be immediately after T015 to emphasize the dependency.
